query:
INSERT INTO task_events (task_id, event_time, event_type, event_payload)
            SELECT value ->> 'task_id',
                   value ->> 'event_time',
                   value ->> 'event_type',
                   value ->> 'event_payload'
            FROM json_each($1)
            ORDER BY key
            RETURNING event_id AS "event_id!"
